title: Converting string references in iterators
prompt: How do you convert an iterator over `&String` into an iterator over `&str` without allocating?
answer: Use `.map(|s| s.as_str())` or `String::as_str` in the iterator pipeline. This yields lightweight borrowed slices referencing the existing heap buffers. Calling `.cloned()` or `.to_string()` instead copies byte contents into newly allocated strings.
